text_block_list.text:
After finishing first with me and her
parents in the
crowd, Эйсин Флэш
expresses her heartfelt
gratitude toward
us.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her parents are thrilled with her victory
and tell
her how proud they are.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her goal achieved, Эйсин Флэш is filled
with
excitement for her final
challenge—the Arima
Kinen. And
although I, too, am excited...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...I decide to draft up a schedule for her
that
extends past the Arima Kinen in the
hope that
she'll continue to run.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
